pairs.subject: concurrent-vcs
pairs.evidence: crates/api/src/jobs.rs:121 This context's 'claim' is a database job-queue claim handed to a runner worker, not a VCS session's claim on a shared checkout; a search of crates/api/src for worktree, GIT_INDEX_FILE, `git stash` and `git commit` found nothing, so none of the subject's precondition (several sessions staging and committing in one checkout) holds in these files.

techniques.evidence: crates/api/src/jobs.rs:121 No pre-commit hook or commit path in this context; the claim is a job row lease.
crates/api/src/jobs.rs:121 The context never runs git commit or push, so there is nothing to read back.
crates/api/src/jobs.rs:121 It never touches a staging index; GIT_INDEX_FILE is absent from crates/api/src.
crates/api/src/jobs.rs:121 It never runs stash, add or reset.
crates/api/src/jobs.rs:121 It creates no worktree; this is runtime service code.
crates/api/src/jobs.rs:121 It does no branch merge-back.
crates/api/src/jobs.rs:121 It keeps no session ledger of editing scopes; the job table is a work queue, not a ledger of who is editing the tree.
